verdict.reasons: The main commercial product is the correct white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll, count 1, with readable AFP branding and the required watermark. The packaging is not misused as operating plumbing and the soil gap is acceptable. However, the installed irrigation evidence clearly shows round, thick black supply hoses/laterals rather than continuous thin flattened drip-tape laterals with localized root-zone wetting. This is a technical evidence mismatch, not merely a minor advisory. It does not make the observed commercial family mixed, but it prevents the technical match condition and keeps the image below the 90-point minimum.
